title: FRTB Standardised Approach (SBM) Demo Calculator
description: Demo sensitivities-based-method delta capital calculation across GIRR, FX and Equity risk classes for a small synthetic portfolio, per BIS MAR21: risk weights, intra-bucket and cross-bucket correlations, and the three correlation scenarios (medium/high/low), reporting the maximum. Educational, delta-only. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

results.description: Per-scenario GIRR/FX/Equity delta capital and total

mcp_tool_definition.name: calculate_frtb_sa_sbm_capital
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes FRTB Standardised Approach sensitivities-based-method delta capital for a synthetic portfolio across GIRR, FX and Equity risk classes: risk weights per MAR21 Tables 1/9/10, intra-bucket correlations (GIRR tenor-decay formula, equity bucket-group percentages), cross-bucket gamma parameters, and the three correlation scenarios (medium/high x1.25 capped 100%/low per the 2x-100% floor formula), reporting the maximum total per MAR21.7. Demo/educational, delta-only, three risk classes only. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/637-frtb-sa-sbm-calculator.html for interactive use.
